alt: Four columns: examined in the original code and images, proved formally in Lean 4 and TLA+, tested side by side on the original and the fixed checker, checked on real runs.
caption: Reading the code, testing parts of a checker, running the whole checker and formal models each answer a different question, so one kind cannot replace another. The side-by-side tests compare the original checker with the version of each fix that was tested, which is not always the latest. One public agent run covers nine fixed tasks: seven were regraded with both checkers, and Lean Analysis was computed from saved verdicts.
